I’ll admit I’m a bit biased after being a longtime patient, but that loyalty is well earned.

Vinny is nothing short of exceptional. I’m extremely sensitive to dental work, and cleanings are usually something I endure rather than enjoy. Today, he completely changed that. His touch is incredibly gentle, precise, and thoughtful. What stood out even more was his presence. Calm, attentive, and genuinely caring. It felt less like a routine cleaning and more like being in the hands of someone who takes real pride in their craft. Honestly, he’s an artist.

Dr. Becker continues to set the standard for what a great dentist should be. He took the time to give me a thorough and honest assessment, walking me through everything in a clear and thoughtful way. What I appreciate most is his integrity. There is absolutely no pressure, no upselling, just straightforward recommendations that put your best interest first.
